snippet.title: Football Heroes League - Official World Premiere Reveal Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
FGS Live From gamescom latam closed with a world premiere trailer for free-to-play football game Football Heroes League from Run Games. Better yet, the reveal trailer was a stealth drop with the game available to play right now. Football Heroes League features 2 vs 2 action with some very unusual players (humanoid lions and manga princesses), with spectacular special moves and precise controls for shooting and passing. Imagine Rocket League meets football meets Fatal Fury and you’ll have some idea. Football League Heroes is free-to-play on Steam and Epic Games Store right now.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
